subject: Request: hosted API ratecard deviation for Q3 POC
messages:
From: Tom Phillips <tom.phillips@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: hosted API ratecard deviation for Q3 POC

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from Acme: we're preparing a Q3 proof-of-concept that will spike Hosted API usage for about 6-8 weeks. Forecast attached (Acme_usage_forecast.xlsx). The ask from procurement is simple: can Redwood provide a temporary deviation from the public rate card (per-token) for the POC window, with a follow-on commitment conversation if the POC meets engagement targets?

Numbers: expected 1.2B tokens in the first month, 900M tokens in the second. We're open to a short-term discount or a capped per-token rate in exchange for a commitment to an enterprise contract if outcomes look good. Legal said they need a clear approval path — who at Redwood needs to sign off?

Tom
Tom Phillips
Head of Integrations, Acme Analytics
procurement@acme-analytics.com

Attachments: Acme_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 62KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Phillips <tom.phillips@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API ratecard deviation for Q3 POC

Tom — thanks for the forecast and context. I copied Ben (Sales Director) and Priyom (Pricing) so we can evaluate options fast. High level from Sales: we can provision a temporary slab/bridge price while the POC runs, but anything outside the published rate card needs a documented approval and a commit (even short-term).

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm target POC start date and exact monthly token caps (you gave a useful range; a firm cap helps us set SLOs).
- Ben/Priyom: can we offer a short-term concession (30–60 days) as a bridge while they sign an SOW? If so, define the floor and whether it requires finance/VP signoff.
- Legal/Procurement: we'll need a 1–page amendment or SOW referencing the temporary rate and the conversion trigger to an enterprise commit.

We can provision an initial temporary rate while we route the formal approval. Tom, if you can confirm the firm monthly cap, I'll start the approval thread.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0143

Attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API ratecard deviation for Q3 POC

Vanessa — looped in. Put this formally into the pricing queue. A couple of practical constraints from Sales/Finance:

- We can grant a temporary bridge discount (not to exceed the published banding thresholds) for up to 60 days without VP approval, provided Finance signs off on the expected ARR conversion probability and the customer signs an SOW that captures the conversion commitment window.
- For the volumes Tom shared, this will materially change unit economics; we need a quick margin check. Priyom — please run the attached ratecard (redwood_ratecard-v2.xlsx) against the forecast and confirm max allowable concession.

Recommended offer to present to Acme (subject to Priyom):
- 10% off published per-token rates for 30 days as a bridge
- If Acme signs a 6-month commit within 45 days post-POC, include step-down pricing to a custom commit slab (to be negotiated)

Vanessa — please ask Acme to upload the SOW draft into the shared Drive and route procurement contacts; I'll shepherd internal approval if the margin check passes.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_ratecard-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 128KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing guidance: Acme Analytics POC
To: Pricing Committee <pricing-committee@redwoodinference.com>

Team — quick summary: Acme requests a temporary deviation from our public hosted per-token rate for a 6–8 week POC with projected peak of ~1.2B tokens/month. They are prepared to commit if outcomes look good.

Immediate guidance (internal):
- We can approve up to a 10% temporary concession on published per-token rates for an initial 30-day bridge without VP signoff, provided:
  * Customer signs a short SOW that includes a conversion trigger and a firm token cap.
  * Finance confirms expected ARR uplift (deal id DEAL-ACME-2027) and margin impact.
- Any concession >10% or duration beyond 60 days requires VP Pricing approval and legal-signed SOW with standard termination clauses.
- For larger, multi-month custom slabs tied to commits (6+ months), pricing will be handled as a custom commit tier; margins guiding bands are attached.

Action items:
1) Vanessa — get firm token caps and the draft SOW (Acme_SOW_v3.pdf referenced).
2) Ben — confirm conversion probability for Finance and land the internal finance review.
3) Pricing Committee — fast-track margin check; if it's within thresholds, we provision the 10% bridge and create a DocuSign SOW template for execution.

I will approve a single 10% bridge for 30 days now to avoid blocking the POC start; anything beyond that we escalate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
